Late in the week, Saturn in your 2nd House squares that pair, stalling money talks and resurfacing debts. Friday is your riskiest day, because Saturn squares Venus, so postpone contracts and guard your cash. One tip: pitch early, sign nothing Friday. Follow now for daily cosmic updates, Aquarius.
